definitions: The grape (fruit of plants of the genus Vitis).

The plant Rubus phoenicolasius, the Japanese wineberry.
Its edible fruit, resembling a raspberry.

blocks.text: Wineberry may refer to the following plants:

items: Aristotelia serrata, a tree which is endemic to New Zealand
Rubus phoenicolasius, a type of raspberry native to Asia and introduced to North America
Vaccinium myrtillus, a fruit also called Bilberry
An archaic term for the grape
